name: Imagined Music
author: WaxClub
origin: Your own AI chip (WaxBrain) + photos from Unsplash
license: Photos from Unsplash, credited to each photographer; scenes chosen by your AI chip
description: An AI visual director reads the lyrics and imagines the song: a slow, cinematic slideshow of photos that follow its verses, moods and colors, behind the lyrics on your TV. In Immersive mode, only the images play, with a striking line of the lyrics fading in about every 30 seconds. Uses an AI chip from your WaxBrain (Gemini is free); photos come from Unsplash and are credited to their photographers.
